# protocols

# Protocol

* [Daily Sweep Protocol](DAILY_SWEEP_PROTOCOL.md) - An unattended run of the existing protocols that opens a pull request. It never writes to main and never deploys.
* [Data Gap Finder Protocol](DATA_GAP_FINDER_PROTOCOL.md) - Fill null fields on models released in the last 6 months from primary sources only (the lab's own announcement or model card, LMArena, official leaderboards); a cell that cannot be verified stays null rather than guessed.
* [Frontier Status Protocol](FRONTIER_STATUS_PROTOCOL.md) - How status in data/models.json is computed by scripts/frontier-status.js — a major-lab flagship recency override plus a per-tier benchmark rule — so frontier is a derived signal that never goes stale by hand.
* [Model Entry Style Guide](MODEL_ENTRY_STYLE_GUIDE.md) - How every record in data/models.json is written, so new models added by the release protocol are indistinguishable in style from existing ones. The UI renders these values verbatim — consistency here…
* [Model Specs Protocol](MODEL_SPECS_PROTOCOL.md) - Find and fill speed, license, apiIds, retirementDate and predecessorId in data/models.json from primary sources; predecessorId requires an explicit replacement claim in the lab's own announcement and is never inferred from naming.
* [News Scan Protocol](NEWS_SCAN_PROTOCOL.md) - Refresh the News tab with all recent frontier-lab news (releases, benchmarks, funding, policy, research): interview Maia on companies, period, categories and depth first, then web-search and append sourced entries to data/news.json.
* [New Model Release Protocol](NEW_MODEL_RELEASE_PROTOCOL.md) - Add a newly released frontier model to data/models.json with web-verified, sourced data so it appears correctly in Directory, Compare and News; frontier status is then computed, never assigned.
* [Stats Filler Protocol](STATS_FILLER_PROTOCOL.md) - Find and fill missing benchmark scores and spec fields (pricing, context window, max output, knowledge cutoff) in data/models.json with verified, sourced values; unverifiable cells are recorded in data/stats-gaps.md so re-runs skip them.
